verdict.rationale: Docs show RunAnywhere's CLI/SDK explicitly supports both on-device models and a hosted 'Wally Cloud' model via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with an explicit `--cloud` flag to switch between local and hosted execution in the same tool (runanywhere-docs-4, -10, -13, -16, -35). However, this is limited to RunAnywhere's own hosted cloud offering rather than demonstrated interop with third-party cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) beyond client compatibility, and no independent/community evidence confirms this cloud-vs-local switching works smoothly in practice. Missing for 10: evidence of multiple distinct third-party cloud providers configurable side-by-side, and independent hands-on confirmation of the cloud/local switch working as documented.
